**[P2] Configure the polling budget and completion check**

This constructor selects the core retriever's 120-second default, and `fetch_records` supplies no `completion_check`. Consequently, an immediately available valid record still takes approximately 130 seconds including the default pre-wait, contrary to the documented ten-second polling window; `--log-poll-timeout` cannot shorten it. Pass an explicit configurable timeout and a completion predicate that validates accumulated records after the retriever's settling period. Add a fake-clock test using the real retriever to cover this lifecycle.
